full_A5_automorphism_enumeration.completeness_method: the fixed pair generates A5; all 60^2 image pairs are extended through the labelled Cayley graph and every accepted bijection is checked on all 60^2 products

full_colour_automorphism_group.completeness_method: exhaustive injective vertex-image backtracking; at every node all unused targets compatible with every already mapped edge colour are tried
